parsed.note_claim: This recirculates a hoax twisting Jay-Z's 2021 Twitter Spaces remark that Beyoncé's Coachella show evolved Michael Jackson's influence.
parsed.label: SUPPORTS
parsed.quote: "Bey's gonna be mad at [me] for saying this, but Michael Jackson never had a Coachella," he said. "She's an evolution of him because she watched him at 9 [years old]."
parsed.reason: The article confirms Jay-Z made the specific 2021 Twitter Spaces remarks about Beyoncé and Michael Jackson's Coachella influence that the note identifies as the source of the hoax.
